description: This file implements the MPSStream class, a key component managing Metal GPU command encoding, synchronization, and profiling for a PyTorch MPS backend. It includes methods for command buffer management, synchronization, copying buffers, and executing MPS graphs.

classes.name: MPSStream
classes.description: A class managing Metal command buffers, encoders, and synchronization for GPU operations within the PyTorch MPS backend.

methods.name: commandBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current command buffer, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the Metal device associated with this stream.

methods.name: commandEncoder
methods.description: Returns the current compute command encoder, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the GPU stream based on the specified SyncType.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current command buffer, potentially enabling continuous command execution.

methods.name: commitAndWait
methods.description: Commits the current command buffer and waits until it is completed.

methods.name: commitAndContinue
methods.description: Commits the command buffer and continues without waiting, used for overlapping command execution.

methods.name: endKernelCoalescing
methods.description: Ends any ongoing kernel coalescing in the command encoder.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the command buffer, committing commands, and handling the previous command buffer based on configuration.

methods.name: addCompletedHandler
methods.description: Adds a handler to be called upon command buffer completion.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a buffer with a specified byte value, batching the operation to avoid issues with large buffers.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data between buffers, batching for large sizes and profiling if enabled.

methods.name: copy_and_sync
methods.description: Copies data between buffers with synchronization, optionally non-blocking.

methods.name: executeMPSGraph
methods.description: Executes an MPS graph with given inputs and results, handling profiling and synchronization.

methods.name: checkLastError
methods.description: Checks the error buffer for any GPU errors and throws exceptions accordingly.
